collection.title: Land Rover 90 1984 to 1990 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Land Rover 90 1984 - 1990 model requires a 14" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
